purpose: Re-audit every augmented member against all five previously retained raw candidates; original analysis remains untouched
high_support_rule: best >=15 inliers and >=.60 fraction, with inlier margin >=max(8, ceil(.25*best)) over every other content-unique retained raw candidate
moderate_support_rule: best >=8 inliers and >=.50 fraction, with margin >=4
content_identity: SHA256 of original parquet decoded RGB shape and pixels; duplicate raw file entries count as one identity
scope_limits: candidate search is limited to the five previously retained raw candidates
positive geometry supports correspondence, not verified plant identity or pathology
multiple raw matches can mean raw near duplicates, not necessarily mixed-source augmentation
